authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the DR-126 platform base/host-ABI TCB and loader-closure design contract: the allowlist taxonomy, the identity/version rule shape, the declared-vs-ambient split, retained loader-trace requirement, and the negative-test classes. It applies nothing, does not populate per-OS package tables, does not re-own DR-G07 extraction, does not re-decide D-006 numbers, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. The DR-126 row remains OPEN until coordinator disposition after independent review.
purpose: Give DR-126 a T2-02 candidate that locks the qualitative TCB shape D-006 left to this row, and reserves populated OS tables as G22 evidence.

registerRowQuoted.locationDiscipline: Located by the line beginning '| DR-126 |'.
registerRowQuoted.rowVerbatim: | DR-126 | Platform base/host-ABI TCB and loader closure | Security + release + platform owners | [Exact-byte delivery](04-lifecycle-delivery-and-operations.md#exact-byte-delivery) | Closed OS ABI/loader/libc/framework/cert/font/ICU-class allowlist and identity rules; retained loader traces; undeclared-system-resolution negative tests | OPEN | Hard blocker for platform qualification |

tcbTextCarriedVerbatim.surroundingLaw: The full Exact-byte delivery section is L141-166. This row owns the last paragraph (TCB). Extraction/symlink/TOCTOU/spawn-binding remain DR-G07 / DR-103.
linesVerbatim: The signed closure also declares the platform base/host-ABI TCB. A closed
allowlist and identity/version rule covers every permitted OS ABI, loader, libc,
framework, certificate store, font, ICU, and comparable system-class dependency.
Loader traces are retained at qualification. Undeclared library/framework/tool
resolution, alternate loader search, or identity drift refuses; hostile clean
machines prove no ambient system dependency can enter silently.

governingSources.role: INHERITED v1-era pin. Named properties only: D-006 qualitative TCB is this row; numbers are G02; D-002 slice platforms. Live digest is the remeasurement block whose standing is LIVE.

identityRuleShape.declared: Every permitted member appears in the signed closure TCB inventory as exactly the four-field signedEntry { platformProfileKey, class, identityEvidence, originSearchPolicy }. That shape is exhaustive. A three-field form is not a conforming signed entry.

identityEvidence.form: See identityEvidenceUnion. Every signed entry carries exactly one tag from the classMap for its class.

identityRuleShape.sameMeans: Two runtime objects are the same member iff platformProfileKey, class, and identityEvidence compare equal under the class-specific rule. The optional sonameAbi companion inside identityEvidence is excluded from that comparison.
identityRuleShape.drift: Any runtime resolution whose authenticity identityEvidence (PLATFORM-ATTESTED or DIGEST-BOUND, excluding sonameAbi) is not an exact allowlist match. Companion presence/absence/mismatch is metadata only: retained, never allow/refuse.
identityRuleShape.populatedTables: Per-OS concrete members are RESERVED as G22 qualification evidence.

loaderTraces.rule: Loader traces are retained at qualification. Absence of a retained trace is a failed qualification.
observationBoundary: every actual resolution or system-class access attempt by the initial image, late loads, descendants, and helper tools, whether or not the object was declared in the signed TCB
descendants and helper tools the core spawns
non-loader system-class accesses (cert/font/ICU-class) covered by the taxonomy
retainedEventSchema: observedAt (monotonic non-negative integer sequence on the run; first post-selection event MUST be > runPreselectionRecord.observedAt)
signedCarrierDigest (UTF-8 hex sha-256 of the signed carrier; MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.signedCarrierDigest)
allowlistDigest (UTF-8 hex sha-256 of the signed allowlist table; distinct from signedCarrierDigest)
observerProcessIdentity (qualification-run verifier process; not a frozen profile field)
mountNamespaceIdentity (Linux only; later events MUST equal the run-level preselection namespace or refuse)
companionObservation (required on a libc event when the signed payload carries sonameAbi; absent otherwise)
loaderTraces.completenessProof: A trace is complete iff the trusted capture protocol reports sensor-health OK and lifecycle closure, and every actual attempt in the observation boundary is present as an event or an independently checkable inapplicability proof. Self-assertion by an incomplete recorder is not completeness. Partial traces fail. There is no harness-capability escape.

captureProtocol.sensor: A trusted capture source independent of the process under test. The recorder MUST NOT declare its own output complete.
captureProtocol.closureProbes: process-tree enumeration and lifecycle closure markers (start, last-descendant-exit, sensor-health) that can reveal an omitted event
captureProtocol.inapplicabilityProof: An explicit independently checkable proof object naming the class, the reason the class cannot occur on this profile, the probe that would have observed it if it could, and the signed carrier digest. A missing probe is not a proof.

evidenceJoin.table: Every observed event MUST match the signed active-profile table or fail. A false allowlistMatch with used outcome is a failed successor.
evidenceJoin.runBinding: Every later event binds runIdentity, subjectDigest, and signedCarrierDigest to the one runPreselectionRecord. later.signedCarrierDigest MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.signedCarrierDigest. later.observedAt MUST be a retained monotonic integer strictly greater than runPreselectionRecord.observedAt under sequenceAndClosure. There is no preselection eventKind.
evidenceJoin.INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME: laterEventVariant volume/type equals runPreselectionRecord; Linux also linuxSelectedMountRecordIdentity.
evidenceJoin.PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED: laterEventVariant.observedAttestation is the captured platform-verification result. scheme/payload MUST equal the signed identityEvidence branch for this class. Volume fields forbidden.
evidenceJoin.EXTERNAL-ORIGIN: laterEventVariant.observedOrigin.actualOrigin is the sensor-emitted origin; lookupStepIndex equals event.route index; actualOrigin binds to resolvedObjectIdentity. Install-root volume fields forbidden.

companionObservationShape.whenRequired: The signed PLATFORM-ATTESTED or DIGEST-BOUND libc payload on this event carries a sonameAbi companion. Observation is then mandatory, not best-effort.
companionObservationShape.whenAbsent: No signed sonameAbi companion is present on this event. companionObservation is omitted.

closedForms.absent: presence=absent. No soname or abiSelector fields.
closedForms.present: presence=present. soname and abiSelector are required and are the exact observed pair.
closedForms.mismatch: presence=mismatch. soname and abiSelector are required and are the exact observed pair used in the comparison.

observerProcessIdentityShape.linux: Verifier {pid, starttime} as overall field 22. Distinct from setnsObservation.helperProcessIdentity. Both are retained.
observerProcessIdentityShape.macos: {pid, kp_proc.p_starttime}. Before-and-after equality required around statfs.

mountNamespaceIdentityShape.linux: inode of the held ns/mnt descriptor. setnsObservation.receivedNsfdInode and helperPostSetnsNsInode MUST equal it.

laterEventVolumeFields.standing: RETIRED. No producer of any generation may emit this schema. EXTERNAL-ORIGIN is origin-only. Volume fields exist only on the INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME laterEventVariant.

loaderTraces.volumeEquality: Delegated to evidenceJoin per tag. INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME only. PATHLESS and EXTERNAL MUST NOT use install-root volume equality.

runPreselectionRecord.standing: Closed qualification-run record. Not an eventKind.
forbidden: volumeConstraint tag fields of later events
runPreselectionRecord.afterSelection: Later events bind runIdentity, subjectDigest, and signedCarrierDigest to this record. completePlatformProfileKey appears only on post-selection events.
runPreselectionRecord.supersedes: v13 eventKind preselection, v14/v15 preselectionRecord alias (deleted), and laterEventVolumeFields. Producers emit runPreselectionRecord only.

fields.val0: int32 first f_fsid component as canonical decimal: optional leading U+002D for negative, then 1-10 digits with no leading zeros except the number 0 itself
fields.val1: int32 second f_fsid component, same canonical decimal

macosVolumeIdentity.componentOrder: val0 then val1. No other order.
macosVolumeIdentity.oneSpelling: +0, 00, and 0 are not three spellings; only 0 is lawful for zero. No plus sign.
macosVolumeIdentity.equality: val0 numeric equal AND val1 numeric equal AND each field uses the canonical decimal spelling

fields.decodedMountPoint: UTF-8 bytes after kernel octal-escape decode; if the decoded bytes are not valid UTF-8, refuse
fields.major: non-negative integer parsed from mountinfo device major
fields.minor: non-negative integer parsed from mountinfo device minor

linuxVolumeIdentity.deviceParse: split mountinfo device on U+003A into exactly two decimal integers; any other form refuses
linuxVolumeIdentity.equality: decodedMountPoint UTF-8 bytes equal AND major numeric equal AND minor numeric equal

payload.package-db: {name: NFC UTF-8, version: NFC UTF-8, digest: 64-hex lowercase sha-256}

observedAttestation.equality: scheme tag equal AND payload fields byte/numeric equal as defined

fields.actualOrigin: full object path after filesystemMeasurementTarget.canonicalization (resolve every symlink; refuse if not exactly one path), then NFC then UTF-8
fields.lookupStepIndex: non-negative integer; MUST equal the index of event.route in the signed allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder

observedOrigin.binding: actualOrigin bytes are the canonical path of resolvedObjectIdentity for this event
observedOrigin.equality: actualOrigin UTF-8 bytes equal signed canonicalOrigin AND lookupStepIndex numeric equal

setnsObservation.when: Linux only. Required on runPreselectionRecord. Forbidden on macOS.
setnsObservation.helperProcessIdentity: {pid, starttime} of the dedicated helper; starttime is overall field 22 (twentieth token after comm final ), index 19)
setnsObservation.receivedNsfdInode: decimal inode of the ns fd the helper received; MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.mountNamespaceIdentity
setnsObservation.helperPostSetnsNsInode: inode of /proc/self/ns/mnt after setns; MUST equal receivedNsfdInode
setnsObservation.mountinfoDigest: 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of the /proc/self/mountinfo bytes read after successful setns. Read ordering is after setnsResult=success and before helper exit.
setnsObservation.failClosed: Mismatch of any required field, missing field, extra field, or helper death refuses the profile.

negativeTests.name: undeclared resolution
negativeTests.passProperty: An undeclared object on the active complete profile refuses. Required for every profile × every taxonomy class, or an explicit proof that the class is absent/inapplicable. Inability to observe or substitute is a qualification failure or platform-removal path, not a skipped cell.

negativeTests.name: alternate loader search
negativeTests.passProperty: A declared-name object found only outside originSearchPolicy.allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder refuses.

negativeTests.name: identity drift
negativeTests.passProperty: A declared-name object whose tagged identityEvidence does not match refuses.

negativeTests.name: hostile clean machine
negativeTests.passProperty: On a clean machine with ambient substitutes present, no undeclared system dependency enters.

g22.testMatrix: every complete platformProfile × every taxonomy class × NT-TCB-1..4, or explicit absent/inapplicable proof. No "that the harness can substitute" quantifier.

whatThisDoesNotDo: Does not SATISFY DR-126 until independently reviewed and recorded by a later D-000 MF-6.
Does not populate per-OS allowlist rows.
Does not re-own archive extraction / symlink / TOCTOU (DR-G07).
Does not re-decide D-006 size numbers.
Does not put language-runtime/Node into the core TCB (those are DR-119 component closures).

selectorGrammar.noOrJoin: A member value MUST NOT be an or-join of alternatives. Distinct filesystems and distinct OS version/build selectors are distinct profiles once populated.
selectorGrammar.beforeAllowlistFreeze: Every required member MUST be populated. Partial preview identity is osFamily+architecture only and cannot freeze an allowlist.

supportedVersionOrBuildSelector.form: closed tagged union owned by this contract

macos-product-build.observation: macOS product-build string as Apple publishes it, after Unicode NFC and trim of leading/trailing ASCII whitespace

linux-distro-userspace.observation: Closed two-field payload. No PLATFORM-ATTESTED platform-image alternate form. uname -r is not a complete Linux host-ABI profile key and is not this scheme.

publisher.source: /etc/os-release ID as published by os-release(5). /usr/lib/os-release is OUT of scope.
publisher.normalization: Unicode NFC, trim leading/trailing ASCII whitespace, ASCII case-fold

other.when: the normalized ID is absent from knownIds
other.digestEncoding: 64 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 encoding of the normalized ID

userspaceRelease.source: /etc/os-release VERSION_ID as published by os-release(5). /usr/lib/os-release is OUT of scope.
userspaceRelease.normalization: Unicode NFC and trim of leading/trailing ASCII whitespace. No case-fold.
userspaceRelease.absent: If VERSION_ID is absent the profile refuses. VERSION is not a substitute. uname -r is not this field.

canonicalIdentifier.serialization: publisherToken + U+003A + userspaceRelease, where publisherToken is the knownId or the OTHER-PUBLISHER token
canonicalIdentifier.normalizationReferent: EXACT-BUILD.equality 'after normalization' means this scheme's per-field normalization followed by this serialization

linux-distro-userspace.notAdmitted: No second form. PLATFORM-ATTESTED platform-image identity is identityEvidence, not this selector.

EXACT-BUILD.equality: same identifierScheme and byte-exact canonicalIdentifier after that scheme's named normalization

CLOSED-RANGE.standing: PROHIBITED as a required-member value until this contract versions a total order per identifierScheme. A CLOSED-RANGE object cannot occupy supportedVersionOrBuildSelector.

supportedVersionOrBuildSelector.serialization: exactly one lawful tag object. The later packet chooses values inside this language and MUST NOT mint range or scheme semantics.
supportedVersionOrBuildSelector.unrecognizedTagOrWildcard: refuses; cannot occupy a required member
supportedVersionOrBuildSelector.schemeBinding: An EXACT-BUILD identifierScheme MUST match the profile osFamily. macos-product-build is lawful only for osFamily=macos. linux-distro-userspace is lawful only for osFamily=linux.

filesystemWhereItAffectsResolution.form: closed tagged identifier owned by this contract

otherTag.lawfulOnlyWhen: the normalized token is absent from identifierEnum
otherTag.normalization: Unicode NFC, ASCII case-fold, trim leading/trailing ASCII whitespace
otherTag.digestEncoding: 64 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 encoding of the normalized token

tokenSourceByOsFamily.macos: filesystemMeasurementTarget.macos. Failure: profile refuses if unobservable.
tokenSourceByOsFamily.linux: filesystemMeasurementTarget.linux. Failure: profile refuses if unobservable, missing, or ambiguous.

otherTag.observationFailure: If the named interface cannot produce the token, the profile refuses.

filesystemWhereItAffectsResolution.equality: enum members compare byte-exact; OTHER-FSTYPE compares algorithmId plus digest

platformProfile.relationToEveryTcbEntry: Every TCB allowlist entry is keyed by a complete platformProfile (all four members). An entry keyed only by osFamily+architecture is a failed successor of a frozen allowlist.
platformProfile.populationPacket: A later packet that supplies these selectors is a different artifact. Standing remains RESERVED. requiredBeforeAllowlistFreeze remains true. This contract authors the grammar, including version/build and filesystem selectors, and does not populate them. This row does not name, designate, or claim independent review of that later packet. Choosing its owner is a separate decision. Windows remains D-002 absent.
platformProfile.memberPopulation: Per-OS concrete TCB members remain RESERVED as G22 evidence on a complete profile.

filesystemMeasurementTarget.computedWhen: BEFORE platformProfile selection and independently of any later object resolution.

signedBinding.name: verifiedInstallRoot
signedBinding.location: signed carrier field verifiedInstallRoot. Not a platformProfile selector member. Not part of completePlatformProfileKey. Not an inventoryFieldAuthor inventory entry.
signedBinding.coexistence: inventoryFieldAuthor remains the single author of inventory bytes. verifiedInstallRoot is a preselection carrier input, not inventory.
signedBinding.scope: Exactly one signed preselection binding point. Not derived from later object resolutions.
signedBinding.valueType: the exact-byte-delivery verified install-root path identity

serialization.treeRootToken: The signed tree root is the single character "/".
serialization.otherTokens: Every other value is a relative UTF-8 path after NFC. It MUST NOT begin with "/", MUST NOT be empty, and MUST NOT contain empty, ".", or ".." components. POSIX / separators. No trailing slash.
serialization.join: The host joins the verified host-local exact-byte install anchor A with the signed token T: if T is "/", the join is A; otherwise the join is A + "/" + T. Canonicalization runs on the join result.

equality.signedTokenBytes: NFC-then-UTF-8 bytes of the carrier field T after grammar validation. This comparison does not use the host-local join.
equality.hostLocalCanonicalPath: Canonicalization of join(A, T) on this host. Filesystem-volume join uses this path only.
equality.notOneComparison: T-byte inequality is a carrier defect. Host-path mismatch is a volume/preselection defect. They are not the same comparison.

serialization.normalization: NFC Unicode, then UTF-8. Normalization and encoding run before grammar validation and before signing.

signedBinding.anchor: the signed full-tree closure root as delivered under exact-byte delivery (file 04 Exact-byte delivery). Rides DR-G07.
signedBinding.absentDependency: If the exact-byte verified-root identity is absent, the profile refuses. This artifact does not invent that identity.

canonicalization.rule: Canonicalize the joined verifiedInstallRoot once, here, before any measurement. Resolve every symbolic-link component. The canonical path is the only path input to macOS statfs and to the Linux mount-point prefix match.
canonicalization.failure: A path that cannot be canonicalized to exactly one path refuses.

targetPath.is: the canonical path produced by canonicalization of signedBinding.verifiedInstallRoot
targetPath.not: ordinary host path resolution, a second live re-read of the install root, or a later object path

filesystemMeasurementTarget.rule: This target is observed BEFORE profile selection and binds the install-root volume. It does not require every later resolution to occupy that volume. INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME later resolutions MUST occupy that volume (sameVolume / volumeEquality). PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED later resolutions MUST NOT be failed for leaving that volume. EXTERNAL-ORIGIN later resolutions join their signed origin, not the install-root volume. A complete profile cannot be selected until this target is observed or the profile refuses.

sameVolume.decision: exact target volume, not merely the filesystem-type token
sameVolume.macosIdentity: same statfs.f_fsid as the preselection observation of targetPath
sameVolume.linuxIdentity: same (decoded mount-point, device) pair as the mountinfo record selected at preselection
sameVolume.retained: Applies only when the signed entry volumeConstraint is INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME. Preselection records the volume identity and the filesystem-type token. That tag's later event compares both: type token must match the selected profile member AND volume identity must equal the preselection identity. PATHLESS and EXTERNAL-ORIGIN MUST NOT be sent through this install-root equality. If an INSTALL-ROOT comparison cannot be made, refuse.

macos.interface: struct statfs.f_fstypename of the volume that contains the canonical targetPath. The path argument is that canonical path. No other interface.
macos.volumeIdentity: struct statfs.f_fsid of that same call
macos.failure: If the token or f_fsid cannot be observed the profile refuses.
macos.observerProcess: observerProcessIdentity is the closed pair {pid, process start time from sysctl kern.proc.pid / kp_proc.p_starttime}. Verify the pair immediately before and after the statfs call; mismatch refuses.
macos.namespace: mountNamespaceIdentity is absent on macOS. There is no inapplicable token and no Linux inode form.

linux.observerProcess: The verifier process that performs preselection observation. observerProcessIdentity is {pid, starttime} where starttime is overall field 22 (twentieth token after comm's final ')', post-delimiter index 19). Open /proc/<pid>/stat and /proc/<pid>/ns/mnt; record {pid,starttime} and fstat the ns fd. The only lawful Linux mountinfo reader is a dedicated helper that (1) receives the held ns fd, (2) enters that namespace with setns(nsfd, CLONE_NEWNS), (3) reads /proc/self/mountinfo, (4) exits. /proc/<verifierPid>/mountinfo opened from the observer's namespace is not the interface. Retain helper {pid,starttime}, the nsfd inode, and evidence that the bytes were read after successful setns. setns failure, helper death, or nsfd stale refuses. Re-read {pid,starttime} and fstat the held ns fd after the helper returns. Any pair or inode change refuses.
linux.namespace: Linux mount-namespace identity is the inode of the held /proc/<pid>/ns/mnt descriptor. The only lawful Linux mountinfo reader is a dedicated helper that (1) receives the held ns fd, (2) enters that namespace with setns(nsfd, CLONE_NEWNS), (3) reads /proc/self/mountinfo, (4) exits. /proc/<verifierPid>/mountinfo opened from the observer's namespace is not the interface. Retain helper {pid,starttime}, the nsfd inode, and evidence that the bytes were read after successful setns. setns failure, helper death, or nsfd stale refuses. Later resolvers MUST present the same inode AND the same selected-record identity or refuse.
linux.source: The only lawful Linux mountinfo reader is a dedicated helper that (1) receives the held ns fd, (2) enters that namespace with setns(nsfd, CLONE_NEWNS), (3) reads /proc/self/mountinfo, (4) exits. /proc/<verifierPid>/mountinfo opened from the observer's namespace is not the interface. Retain helper {pid,starttime}, the nsfd inode, and evidence that the bytes were read after successful setns. setns failure, helper death, or nsfd stale refuses.
linux.mountPointDecoding: decode kernel octal escapes (space, tab, newline, backslash) in the mount-point field before any comparison
linux.recordSelection: over decoded mount points, the record whose mount-point is the longest component-ancestor prefix of the canonical targetPath; if several records share that mount point, the last such record in file order. String prefix on undecoded bytes is not the comparison.
linux.retargeting: If between preselection and a later resolution the selected record's (decoded mount-point, device) pair changes, refuse.
linux.token: the first field after the '-' separator in that selected record (fs_vfstype). Not a numeric field ordinal. Linux struct statfs.f_type is not the token.
linux.failure: If verifiedInstallRoot is absent or non-unique, or canonicalization fails, or the token or volume identity cannot be observed, or selection is missing or ambiguous, the profile refuses.

order: Observe filesystemMeasurementTarget and refuse if unobservable/ambiguous.
Select the active complete (not stem-only) qualified platformProfile whose filesystem member matches that target.

Read the signed entry's volumeConstraint. If INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME: observe the actual object path, canonicalize it by the same symlink-resolving rule, select the object's volume by the same algorithm; the object's volume identity MUST equal the preselection volume identity AND the object's filesystem-type token MUST match the already-selected profile filesystem member; otherwise refuse. If PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED: do not require an object path or install-root volume equality; join the named pathlessObservation. If EXTERNAL-ORIGIN: join canonicalOrigin / allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder; do not require install-root volume equality.
Allow only an exact allowlist match under identityEvidenceUnion AND originSearchPolicy.
Every other source or route is ambient/alternate and MUST refuse.
resolutionPredicate.g22VersusQualified: G22 exercises a frozen candidate profile. Only a passing G22 result makes the profile qualified. A stem-only profile cannot enter G22.
resolutionPredicate.declaredVersusAmbient: Declared = complete-profile allowlist entry + originSearchPolicy. Ambient = any other object or route.

tcbCarrier.authoritativeInventoryCarrier: The published signed-closure inventory. Exactly one copy.
tcbCarrier.inventoryFieldAuthor: The DR-101 successor (distribution-core-inventory-contract lineage) authors the inventorySchema TCB / layer-table field. DR-103 consumes that field in fixture/schema work and does not author a second carrier.
tcbCarrier.bindingPoint: inventorySchema TCB members keyed by complete platformProfile. The field does not exist until that one DR-101 successor authors it. verifiedInstallRoot is not an inventorySchema TCB member and is not keyed by complete platformProfile.
tcbCarrier.signatureCeremonyOwner: OD-101-2 ceremony independently; adjacent DR-112 signed-index mechanics. Not this row. Not a slash-joined owner of the inventory field.
tcbCarrier.dependencyIfCarrierAbsent: G22 cannot QUALIFY until that one signed carrier exists and is bound. A population packet is not a substitute carrier.

verifiedInstallRoot.kind: non-inventory preselection field on the same published signed-closure carrier
verifiedInstallRoot.author: DR-126 (this artifact). Not inventoryFieldAuthor. Not a second inventory author.
verifiedInstallRoot.ceremony: OD-101-2 signs the carrier that already carries the DR-101 inventory field and this verifiedInstallRoot field. This row does not own the ceremony.
verifiedInstallRoot.comesIntoExistence: When that one signed carrier exists. If the carrier is absent, dependencyIfCarrierAbsent still applies (G22 cannot QUALIFY). If the carrier exists and verifiedInstallRoot is absent or non-unique, filesystemMeasurementTarget refuses.
verifiedInstallRoot.equality: Two comparisons, not one. signedTokenBytes are the NFC-then-UTF-8 bytes of the carrier field after grammar validation. hostLocalCanonicalPath is the observer's canonicalization of that token on this host. Filesystem-volume join uses hostLocalCanonicalPath. Token-byte inequality is a carrier defect, not a volume mismatch.
verifiedInstallRoot.supersedesPriorEquality: Any earlier single-comparison sentence that equated the signed token with the host path is superseded by equality (signedTokenBytes vs hostLocalCanonicalPath).

PLATFORM-ATTESTED.requires: verification of the actual resolved object through a trusted platform attestation. Unconstrained version strings are not this tag.

signedPayloadUnion.package-db: {name: NFC UTF-8, version: NFC UTF-8, digest: 64-hex lowercase sha-256}
signedPayloadUnion.noEquivalentEscape: There is no equivalent/other scheme. Unknown scheme refuses.

PLATFORM-ATTESTED.pathlessOsAbiSubject: For PATHLESS OS ABI, the attested subject is the running kernel ABI identity named by the signed payload, not an object path.
PLATFORM-ATTESTED.comparisonToObserved: observedAttestation.scheme/payload MUST equal this signedPayloadUnion member exactly.

optionalLibcCompanion.comparison: sonameAbi is metadata only. Presence, absence, or mismatch NEVER changes allow/refuse and is not authenticity drift. Retained as companionObservation.

DIGEST-BOUND.requires: named collision-resistant digest algorithm identifier plus a canonical collection membership/root rule over the observed bytes.

optionalLibcCompanion.comparison: sonameAbi is metadata only. Presence, absence, or mismatch NEVER changes allow/refuse and is not authenticity drift. Retained as companionObservation.

identityEvidenceUnion.comparison: The harness compares the observed resolved object to the tagged authenticity evidence. Selector exactness is EXACT-BUILD under identifierSchemes. CLOSED-RANGE is prohibited. Filesystem other-types use OTHER-FSTYPE. SONAME-ABI lives under companions, not tags. sonameAbi never decides identity and never changes allow/refuse.

SONAME-ABI.encoding: named optional field sonameAbi: { soname, abiSelector } inside a PLATFORM-ATTESTED or DIGEST-BOUND libc payload
SONAME-ABI.comparison: metadata only. Presence, absence, or mismatch NEVER changes allow/refuse. Authenticity remains the attested or digest-bound object. When a signed sonameAbi companion is present, the corresponding libc event MUST retain companionObservation in the closed form above. Not identity drift.

pathlessClasses.onlyIf: PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED may be used only for these classes. Other classes MUST NOT use that tag.
pathlessClasses.rule: These classes MUST use volumeConstraint PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED. A file-backed install-root volume predicate cannot represent them.

originSearchPolicy.canonicalOrigin: Owned only inside volumeConstraint.tags.EXTERNAL-ORIGIN.signedObject for EXTERNAL entries. The pre-existing originSearchPolicy.canonicalOrigin prose is the human meaning; the signed location is the tag object.
originSearchPolicy.allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder: Closed ordered list of lookup steps. Anything outside the list is alternate and refuses.

environmentInfluence.entries: Each named variable maps to exactly one of { standing: FIXED, expectedValue: <canonical string> } or { standing: FORBIDDEN }. Unnamed variables have standing FORBIDDEN.
environmentInfluence.pathAndLoaderDefault: PATH and loader-config substitution variables (LD_LIBRARY_PATH, DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH, LD_PRELOAD, DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, and class-equivalent loader substitution variables) are FORBIDDEN unless the signed entry lists the variable with standing FIXED and a concrete expectedValue. Naming the variable without a fixed value does not make substitution lawful.
environmentInfluence.lookupBinding: Every allowed lookup step in allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder is bound to immutable platformProfile plus signed-entry evidence. A step whose inputs include a FORBIDDEN or unnamed variable refuses.

originSearchPolicy.classAppropriateLookup: Class-specific tool/data lookup rule, or null if the class has none.

volumeConstraint.form: closed tagged union. Required on every signed entry. This is the only signed location of canonicalOrigin and pathlessObservation. Extra fields rejected.

INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME.join: runPreselectionRecord volume/type equality; Linux also selected-record identity

signedObject.pathlessObservation: required; only signed location of this field

signedObject.canonicalOrigin: required; a full object path after the same symlink-resolving canonicalization as filesystemMeasurementTarget.canonicalization. NFC then UTF-8. Not a search-root identity.

EXTERNAL-ORIGIN.join: actualOrigin UTF-8 bytes MUST equal signed canonicalOrigin UTF-8 bytes at /signedEntry/originSearchPolicy/volumeConstraint/tags/EXTERNAL-ORIGIN/signedObject/canonicalOrigin. lookupStepIndex equals event.route. actualOrigin is the canonicalized path of resolvedObjectIdentity. Install-root volume equality is forbidden.

volumeConstraint.defaultForbidden: A signed entry with no volumeConstraint tag is a failed successor. Cross-tag fields rejected.

originSearchPolicy.pathlessObservation: Owned only inside volumeConstraint.tags.PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED.signedObject. Not a sibling field.
